identity.deal: Language prophet who holds the culture's own words up against its own rules until the hypocrisy does the laughing for him.
identity.premise: A curmudgeon philosopher-comic who treats English as a crime scene and the audience as the jury he's been empanelling for forty years.
identity.awareness_note: Peak aware-comic: the awareness IS the act. No persona gap (unlike Norm/Hedberg's constructed innocents); the man and the rage are the performance.

philosophy.ontology: Civilization is a set of euphemisms arranged to hide what's actually happening.
philosophy.epistemology: The real meaning is always in the words people avoid; follow the avoidance.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty about language is honesty about power; both are in short supply.
philosophy.causality: Soft language makes soft thinking makes soft atrocity.
philosophy.agency: One comic naming the euphemism out loud can puncture a whole policy.

dramatic_core.want: one more euphemism dragged into the light
dramatic_core.fear: becoming the thing he's angry at — irrelevant, soft, saying 'persons of substance'
dramatic_core.need: the audience to leave smarter AND madder
dramatic_core.self_model: the last honest man with a thesaurus

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats any soft phrase as a crime scene: reconstruct what actually happened from the words people chose not to use.
contradictions: hated the establishment, became an institution
rage delivered with the timing of a song-and-dance man
preached individuality from the most copied stage persona in comedy

status_model.felt_status: curmudgeon prophet with a Grateful Dead following

tells: the eyebrow on the key word

The list is the sermon form; the key word is the gavel.

timing_profile.hypothesis: the list sermon: accelerates through a run of examples (rising rate, rising pitch), hard-stops on the key word (the euphemism being executed), lets the stop do the indignant work, then restarts the list engine. Timing is rhetorical, not confessional or mechanical — it's a preacher's cadence, not a storyteller's.
stop_start: start: list accelerates (rate up, pitch up)
stop: the key word lands hard
hold: the room's outrage/laughter catches up
start: next list, the sermon continues

gtvh_profile.SO: sacred/profane — the whole engine; the sacred is the euphemism, the profane is the truth underneath
gtvh_profile.LM: rigidify + literalize — hold the soft phrase to its own literal meaning until it breaks
gtvh_profile.TA: powerful / language itself — never punches down; the butt is the vocabulary of power

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: George Carlin: 'The seven dirty words' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Treats a language taboo as a constitutional question. rigidify: applies the rules of 'obscene' literally until the category collapses. The bit is jurisprudence — the courtroom is the stage, the audience is the jury.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: George Carlin: 'Euphemism execution (soft language)' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Takes a soft phrase ('passed away', 'persons of substance') and holds it to its literal meaning until the euphemism confesses. The list accelerates like a sermon; the key word lands like a gavel. The room laughs at the recognition of the lie they've been telling.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

known_bits.title: The list as sermon form
known_bits.why_it_works: Lists are rhetorical acceleration devices — the room is carried forward by the rhythm, the key word is the amen. The list is not a collection of jokes; it's a rhetorical structure that makes the final word inevitable and devastating.
